setting_invalid: A setting value was not accepted, so it was not saved. Check its format and value, then save again.
content_limit_exceeded: This list can hold at most {{limit}} items. Remove some and save again.
announcement_not_found: This announcement no longer exists. Refresh the list.
email_test_failed: The test email could not be sent. Check the SMTP settings; the mail server's reply is in the server log.
email_test_recipient_missing: Your account has no email address, so there is nowhere to send the test. Add an email address to your account first.
email_recipients_required: No recipients were chosen, so nothing was sent. Choose users or send to everyone.
announcement_email_content_missing: There is no announcement to send. Enter a title and content, or publish an announcement first.
translation_token_missing: Translation needs an API key of your own, and you have none that works. Create or enable a key, then try again.
feedback_request_not_found: No request with this ID was found for your account. Check the request ID.
database_unreachable: The server cannot reach its database. Check the database service and try again.
email_domain_not_allowed: This email domain is not accepted here. Use an address from an allowed domain.
email_alias_not_allowed: Addresses with “+” or “.” before the @ are not accepted. Use your plain address.
password_invalid: The password must be 8 to 64 characters and no more than 72 bytes. Choose another password.
password_reset_link_invalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
password_reset_client_upgrade_required: This page is out of date and your link has not been used. Reload the page and set the password again.
mail_not_found: The archived mail was not found.
mail_resend_failed: The archived mail could not be resent. Check the delivery details.
admin_email_missing: Add an email address to your account before sending a preview.
mail_regenerate_failed: The mail could not be regenerated. Regenerate drafts from the usage digest page.
mail_send_failed: The mail could not be sent. Check the delivery details.
telegram_not_configured: Telegram is not set up for this deployment: {{reason}}. Set telegram.bot_token and telegram.ops_chat in the deployment config, then restart.
telegram_send_failed: Telegram did not accept the message: {{reason}}. Check that the bot is a member of the chat and that the chat id is right.
telegram_mute_invalid: The mute length must be a whole number of minutes from 0 to 10080 (one week). 0 lifts the mute.
